purpose: Assemble the final citizen-facing property answer from an approved answer plan and verified evidence, legal analysis, chronology, relationships, limitations and next actions.
core_principle: APPROVED PLAN → VERIFIED CONTENT → PLAIN-LANGUAGE ANSWER → TRACEABLE SOURCES
rules: Only approved verified components may be assembled into a definitive answer.
The answer must follow the approved scope and not silently broaden the investigation.
Facts, legal propositions and causal explanations remain distinct.
Historical answers retain historical dates and applicable legal versions.
Deadlines are included only when verified for the specific issue and trigger.
A possible route is not presented as a guaranteed remedy.
Every material answer component retains traceability to evidence or legal authority.
Public output excludes restricted evidence and unnecessary personal information.
hard_stops: Never assemble from an unapproved answer plan.
Never turn an unresolved cause into a definitive explanation.
Never invent a deadline, authority, remedy or next action.
Never expose internal reasoning or restricted evidence.
Never create a new legal conclusion during prose assembly.
